name: console-status
description: Claude Console：跨專案 STATUS、Claude/Codex 派工、工作階段與用量總覽（含手機 Remote Control）

registryPath.title: Project registry
registryPath.description: Absolute path or ~/ path to the project registry.

companionScript.title: Companion script
companionScript.description: Absolute path or ~/ path to codex-companion.mjs; blank or stale auto-resolves to the newest installed Codex plugin.

companionStateDir.title: Companion state directory
companionStateDir.description: Legacy Temp state root, also passed unchanged to preflight. Blank uses LOCALAPPDATA/Temp/codex-companion (system temp on other platforms).

dispatchSettingsPath.title: Dispatch settings file
dispatchSettingsPath.description: Absolute or ~/ path to the shared Claude/Codex dispatch settings.

claudeSessionsPath.title: Claude sessions file
claudeSessionsPath.description: Absolute or ~/ path used to persist project-root to Claude session mappings.

executor.title: Default executor
executor.description: Fallback executor when dispatch.json is unavailable: claude or codex.

modelsCachePath.title: Model cache
modelsCachePath.description: Absolute or ~/ path to the Codex models cache.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Fallback when the settings file or model field is unavailable; blank uses the selected executor default.

defaultEffort.title: Default effort
defaultEffort.description: Fallback when the settings file or effort field is unavailable; blank uses the selected executor default.

codexFallback.title: Codex fallback
codexFallback.description: When Codex quota is low or its broker/companion is unusable: ask (hold and offer Claude), claude (dispatch with Claude), or off.

codexMinQuotaPercent.title: Codex minimum quota
codexMinQuotaPercent.description: Remaining Codex quota percent below which the fallback applies; readings older than 6 hours count as unknown.

companionStateRoots.title: Companion state roots
companionStateRoots.description: JSON array of root paths. Blank reads plugin data first, then companionStateDir (Temp).

gitProbe.title: Git and PR status
gitProbe.description: on: each project's branch, uncommitted and unpushed work (git) plus its pull request and CI checks (gh, when installed). git: local git only. off: neither.

commandGuard.title: Command guard
commandGuard.description: ask: an irreversible shell command (recursive delete, force push, hard reset, git clean, dropped tables, publish) asks you first, even when permissions would let it run. deny: always refuse them. off: no guard.

loopGuard.title: Loop guard
loopGuard.description: on: a tool call that fails twice with the same arguments and the same error tells Claude not to try a third time. off: no note.

cacheHint.title: Prompt cache hint
cacheHint.description: on: show when the console's prompt cache goes cold and what re-writing it costs (band chip, pane line, toasts). off: hide.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto: the TTL the API reports in the transcript usage (5m until seen). 5m or 1h: fixed.

cacheWritePrice.title: Cache write price
cacheWritePrice.description: USD per million cache-write tokens for the cost estimate; blank uses the model's list price (1.25x input for 5m, 2x for 1h).

autoSync.title: Auto sync
autoSync.description: on: when finished executor work left a project's STATUS CARD behind (待同步), dispatch one sync by itself, once per job; a sync that fails or writes nothing is not retried. off: wait for the 同步 button.

suggestNext.title: Suggest the next step
suggestNext.description: on: offer the way on (a decision, a reply to an executor that asked, a gate, a sync, a continue) as the prompt box's dim suggestion, Tab to take. off: leave the box to Claude Code's own suggestions.

activation.title: Console activation
activation.description: auto: a session runs the console (polling, band, project mode, cache hints, update check) only after /console is used in it, and again when that session resumes; other sessions get only the command guard. always: every session runs it. /console off turns it off for one session.

projectMode.title: Project mode
projectMode.description: auto: in a session opened inside a registered project, show that project's pipeline in the band and pane, add the CARD contract to the system prompt and attach progress to prompts when it changes. off: always the multi-project console. /console mode overrides per session.
